about: Copy changes the lead decided on (FIX_BRIEF, 2026-10-17): D1 homepage and shared headings, D6 minimal factual corrections, and D5's split of the one-block Ahwatukee body. Same format as the slop files; these run after them, so an edit here may change a slop edit's new text.

edits.old_text: Electrician solutions tailored to your needs
edits.new_text: Electrical work we do, from repairs to EV chargers
edits.reason: D1: stock heading ("solutions tailored to your needs") over the What we do checklist; the replacement is the slop-pages review's suggestion. The homepage title and H1 stay frozen.
D1: the highlighted words follow the new heading (as slop-pages-043 does on /commercial-electrician).

edits.old_text: Let our reviews speak for themselves
edits.reason: D1: cliché heading; the same replacement as slop-pages-045 on /commercial-electrician.
D1: the highlighted words follow the new heading.

edits.old_text: We proudly serve the entire valley!
edits.new_text: We serve the entire Phoenix valley
edits.reason: D1: "proudly serve" plus exclamation; the same line as slop-pages-018, -032 and -036 on the pages that reuse this section.
D1: the highlighted words follow the new heading.
D1: "Solutions" filler in a capability title (homepage checklist and the 404 page's list); the link to the Custom Lighting service is unchanged.
D1: "Solutions" filler in a capability title; the replacement is the slop-pages review's suggestion.
D1: stock benefit title; the replacement is the card's own promise ("get it done right the first time").

edits.new_text: We come back if anything's wrong
edits.reason: D1: stock benefit title. The card already makes the claim: "we'll always come back if you have any issues" (live copy, kept by slop-pages-012). Straight apostrophe like the card's own text.

edits.old_text: We're ready to work for you
edits.new_text: You'll know the price before we start
edits.reason: D1: the shared closing band's heading (every page with the estimate band) was a stock line. The replacement is the business's flat-rate promise from /faq: "we quote you a price before we start and that's what you pay". The band's eyebrow says "Free estimates" and its button "Get a Free Estimate".

splits.reason:
D5: the Webflow export holds Ahwatukee's whole article in one block, its paragraphs and neighbourhood list separated by line breaks, so it rendered as one paragraph full of
s. After the slop-cities edits it becomes one block per paragraph, and the neighbourhoods a bullet list under their bold label, like the other nine cities.
